describe.vlm_prompt:
Please use the Template to briefly describe the image of {name} in only one sentence. Template:
'A photo of {name} [doing/done], with [distinctive features], in [specific scenes].'

extend.extension_prompt:
Besides these descriptions mentioned above, please use the Template 1 to list exactly {number} other possible [doing/done], [distinctive features] and [specific scenes].
Template1: A photo of {name} [doing/done], [with distinctive features] in [specific scenes]. 
List the selected sentences numbered from 1 to {number}, one per line. Do not output more than {number} descriptions.
extend.determine_prompt: From the provided description list, determine which sentences are unrealistic or reduce diversity. Output one 1-based sequence number per line for every sentence that needs reflection. Do not output anything else. If all sentences are good, return 'apple'.
extend.reflection_prompt:
From the provided description list, please select exactly {number} unique sentences for  '{name}'. 
Each sentence must describe a different [doing/done], [distinctive feature] (e.g., texture, shape) or a [specific scene] (e.g., lighting, environment) to ensure diversity. Avoid near-duplicates.
List the selected sentences numbered from 1 to {number}, one per line. Do not output more than {number} descriptions.
extend.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant that generates diverse and detailed image descriptions for image classification datasets.

generate.reflect_one_prompt:
From the description above, please regenerate a better description for '{name}'. The sentence must describe a different [distinctive feature] (e.g., texture, shape) or a [specific scene] (e.g., lighting, environment) to ensure diversity. Avoid near-duplicates. Must using the Template:
'A photo of {name} [doing/done], with [distinctive features], in [specific scenes].'
